how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

sentences.ar: لما الملف يبقى أكبر من جهاز واحد، بتقسّمه.
sentences.en: When a file is larger than one machine, you split it.

sentences.ar: الـHDFS بيقطّعه blocks ويوزّعهم على DataNodes، وبيحتفظ بأكتر من نسخة من كل block على أجهزة مختلفة ويا ريت على racks مختلفة.
sentences.en: HDFS cuts it into blocks and scatters them across DataNodes, keeping several copies of each block on different machines and ideally different racks.

sentences.ar: والـNameNode ماسك الخريطة أنهي block فين وعمره ما بيلمس الداتا نفسها، وعشان كده ضياعه كارثة metadata مش كارثة داتا.
sentences.en: The NameNode holds the map — which block lives where — and never touches your data, which is why losing it is a metadata catastrophe and not a data one.

sentences.ar: اقتل DataNode وبصّ: الملف لسه بيتقرا من النسخ الباقية، والـcluster بيبدأ في الهدوء يعمل نسخ جديدة عشان يرجّع معامل التكرار.
sentences.en: Kill a DataNode and watch: the file is still readable from the surviving replicas, and the cluster quietly starts making new copies to restore the replication factor.

sentences.ar: دي fault tolerance كحركة مش كجملة في slide.
sentences.en: That is fault tolerance as motion rather than as a sentence on a slide.

sentences.ar: والفكرة التانية هي اللي غيّرت الصناعة: ودّي الحساب للداتا، مش الداتا للحساب، لأن نقل تيرابايتات على الشبكة هو الجزء الغالي.
sentences.en: The second idea is the one that changed the industry: move the computation to the data, not the data to the computation, because moving terabytes across a network is the expensive part.

sentences.ar: والـMapReduce هو الشكل اللي طلع من ده.
sentences.en: MapReduce is the shape that came from it.

sentences.ar: والـshuffle بيبعت كل زوج ليه نفس الـkey لنفس المكان والسهم ده هو الشبكة، وعشان كده الـshuffle هو اللحظة اللي تتفرّج عليها.
sentences.en: Shuffle sends every pair with the same key to the same place — and that arrow is the network, which is why shuffle is the moment to watch.

sentences.ar: والـreduce بينتج الإجماليات. Spark استبدل التنفيذ مش الشكل، وعشان كده ده لسه يستاهل تسعين ثانية.
sentences.en: Reduce produces the totals. Spark replaced the implementation but not the shape, which is why this is still worth ninety seconds.

sentences.ar: والنظام البيئي اللي حواليه Sqoop وFlume وOozie وZooKeeper وTez وAmbari وHive وHBase مكانه خط زمني ومعاه حكم أمين لكل واحد:
sentences.en: And the ecosystem around it — Sqoop, Flume, Oozie, ZooKeeper, Tez, Ambari, Hive, HBase — belongs on a timeline with an honest verdict each:

sentences.ar: حلّ إيه، اتستبدل بإيه، وهل هتمدّ إيدك عليه النهارده.
sentences.en: What it solved, what replaced it, and whether you would reach for it today.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: Hadoop Distributed File System: splits files into blocks spread across DataNodes and keep…
concepts.failure: Storing huge numbers of tiny files, which overload the NameNode's metadata memory.

concepts.def_en: The HDFS master that holds the cluster's map in memory (which block lives on which DataNode) but never stores the file data itself.
concepts.def_ar: الـnamenode هو الـmaster في HDFS؛ شايل خريطة الـcluster في الذاكرة (أنهي block على أنهي DataNode) ومابيلمسش الداتا نفسها.
concepts.failure: Thinking the NameNode stores file data; it holds only the map to the blocks.

concepts.def_en: Data about data: schemas, locations, sizes and state that describe and track the actual d…
concepts.failure: Treating metadata loss as harmless; without the map, intact data is unreadable.

concepts.def_en: An HDFS worker machine that stores the actual data blocks and serves reads and writes, while the NameNode tracks where each block lives.
concepts.def_ar: الـDataNode جهاز worker في HDFS بيخزّن الـblocks الفعلية وبيرد على القراية والكتابة، والـNameNode هو اللي عارف كل block فين.
concepts.failure: Thinking one DataNode failing loses data, though replicas sit on other nodes.

concepts.def_en: A distributed processing model: map transforms records into key-value pairs, shuffle groups them by key, reduce aggregates each group.
concepts.def_ar: الـmapreduce نموذج معالجة موزّع: الـmap بيحوّل السجلات لأزواج key-value، والـshuffle بيجمّعها بالـkey، والـreduce بيلخّص كل مجموعة.
concepts.failure: Overlooking that the shuffle between map and reduce, not the compute, dominates runtime.

concepts.def_en: Redistributing data across machines over the network so rows with the same key land together; the heaviest, costliest step in distributed jobs.
concepts.def_ar: الـshuffle هو نقل الداتا بين الأجهزة على الشبكة حسب الـkey، عشان نفس الـkey يتجمّع في مكان واحد؛ وهو أتقل مرحلة.
concepts.failure: Treating shuffle as free; it moves data over the network and dominates job time.

concepts.def_en: Apache Spark: a distributed engine that processes large datasets in parallel across a clu…
concepts.failure: Using Spark for small data, where cluster overhead outweighs any speed gain.

A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
Blocks replicated across nodes; a node fails and blocks re-replicate.
Kafka-style topic partitions as lanes with consumers, offsets and lag.
Trunk chapter title card (riser + sting in the SFX map).
